name: 4D Shapes
summary:
4D Shapes is a VR geometry studio and sandbox for exploring higher-dimensional forms.

Create recognizable 4D families including tesseracts, polytopes, shells, honeycombs, smooth manifolds, and experimental shapes. Rotate through 4D planes, inspect structure from inside and outside, and use controller-first tools built for headset exploration.

Tune each object with face colors, opacity, ramps, edge thickness, vertex size, labels, effects, and presets. Build vivid abstract visuals or keep the geometry clean
